ICS 91.140.60
CED 24
CED 24
New Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
This standard lays down the requirements for filter sand and gravel used in filtration of water.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions, which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreement based on these standards are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
